title: Touch2O capacitive activation not working
shortDescription: Tapping the spout or handle no longer starts water flow.
fullDescription:
Delta Touch2O requires a solid ground connection from the control box to the faucet body to read a valid capacitance change. A missing or loose white ground wire, or an unplugged solenoid, is the primary cause.

Also verify the system is not in Disable mode (hold faucet for 30 s to toggle).

fixSteps.title: Re-enable touch
fixSteps.instruction: Do not touch faucet for 30 seconds to exit disabled mode.

fixSteps.title: Check wiring
fixSteps.instruction: Under sink, verify solenoid and ground wires fully seated in control box.

whenToCallPro: If wiring and battery are fine but no response.

faq.a: Cleaning the faucet without triggering flow.

title: Touch2O battery pack depleted
shortDescription: LED flashes red indicating low batteries.
fullDescription: Delta Touch2O uses 6 AA batteries in a battery pack under the sink. When voltage drops, the LED at the base of the faucet flashes red. Replace all six batteries with fresh alkalines.

fixSteps.title: Replace batteries
fixSteps.instruction: Open battery box under sink, install 6 new AA alkalines.

faq.a: About 2 years for a typical household.

title: Voice commands not dispensing water
shortDescription: VoiceIQ module has lost connection or Alexa/Google skill unlinked.
fullDescription:
Delta VoiceIQ adds a Wi-Fi and voice-control module to Touch2O faucets. If the module loses Wi-Fi, voice commands routed from Alexa or Google Home fail.

Verify module online in the Delta Faucet app and re-link the voice skill if needed.

fixSteps.title: Check app
fixSteps.instruction: Open Delta Faucet app and confirm module connected.

fixSteps.title: Re-link skill
fixSteps.instruction: Disable and re-enable Delta Faucet in Alexa or Google Home.

title: Solenoid clicks but water does not start
shortDescription: Solenoid activates but no water flow.
fullDescription:
Hearing a click under the sink means the solenoid is receiving a signal. No flow after the click suggests a closed manual handle, closed angle stops, or debris blocking the solenoid diaphragm.

Confirm handle is open and supply lines are pressurized, then flush the solenoid.

fixSteps.title: Open handle
fixSteps.instruction: Touch2O requires the manual handle to be in the ON position for flow.

fixSteps.title: Flush solenoid
fixSteps.instruction: Shut water, disconnect solenoid lines, flush with clean water.

whenToCallPro: If solenoid still fails after flush.
videoSearchQuery: Delta Touch2O solenoid clicks no water

faq.a: Touch2O only dispenses when handle is open — touch simply valves on/off.

title: Faucet will not shut off
shortDescription: Water continues running even without touch activation.
fullDescription:
If the Touch2O continues running after 2 minutes, the timer-shutoff did not occur. Usually caused by repeated false triggers or a stuck solenoid. A firmware quirk or a short in the touch wire can cause continuous re-triggering.

Disable Touch2O by holding for 30 s, then diagnose wiring.

fixSteps.title: Close handle
fixSteps.instruction: Immediately close the manual handle to stop flow.

fixSteps.title: Disable Touch2O
fixSteps.instruction: Hold the faucet for 30 s until LED turns off.

whenToCallPro: If wiring inspection does not resolve.

title: Control box reports fault via solid red LED
shortDescription: A solid (non-blinking) red LED indicates a system fault.
fullDescription: Delta Touch2O uses LED patterns to communicate: blinking red is low battery, solid red indicates a detected fault such as a shorted cable or invalid ground reference. Disconnect and reconnect the battery pack to reset; check wiring.

fixSteps.title: Inspect harness
fixSteps.instruction: Check every connector on the control box for pinched or damaged wires.

whenToCallPro: If reset and visual inspection fail.

title: Temp2O LED indicator not changing color
shortDescription: Base-light indicator fails to show water temperature.
fullDescription:
Temp2O models include an LED ring at the base that changes color based on water temperature. If the ring stays one color, the inline thermistor has failed or its cable is unplugged.

The faucet still works for flow; replace the thermistor assembly if temperature indication is desired.

fixSteps.title: Check connector
fixSteps.instruction: Under sink, inspect thermistor plug at control box.

faq.a: No, it's indication only — mixing is manual.

title: VoiceIQ will not complete onboarding
shortDescription: App cannot add faucet during setup.
fullDescription: VoiceIQ requires a 2.4 GHz SSID broadcast separately from 5 GHz during setup, the phone on the same SSID, and location permissions granted to the Delta Faucet app. Many setup failures trace back to a combined-band router or missing location services.

fixSteps.title: Split bands
fixSteps.instruction: In router admin, temporarily disable 5 GHz or set unique 2.4 GHz SSID.

fixSteps.title: Grant location
fixSteps.instruction: Enable Location permission for Delta Faucet app in phone settings.

fixSteps.title: Retry onboarding
fixSteps.instruction: Follow app setup again with phone on 2.4 GHz SSID.

faq.a: To scan nearby Wi-Fi networks on iOS/Android.
